cues.en: Hi everyone. Welcome to another episode of Coding Adventures.
cues.zh: 大家好。欢迎来到另一集 Coding Adventures。

cues.en: Today we're going to be experimenting with some little ant and slime simulations.
cues.zh: 今天我们要试验一些小小的蚂蚁和史莱姆模拟。

cues.en: But first, I'd like you to imagine that you're a merchant who travels from town to town selling cabbages.
cues.zh: 但首先，我想请你想象自己是一个商人，在各个城镇之间旅行卖卷心菜。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 那么

cues.en: you'd like to find a path that takes you through all the towns on this map, arriving back home in the shortest possible distance.
cues.zh: 你想找到一条路径，能带你走遍这张地图上的所有城镇，并以尽可能短的距离回到家里。

cues.en: Here's some slightly confusing code which recursively generates all the possible solutions to this problem, and each of these solutions is evaluated in this function over here, simply by calculating the length of the path and then saving it if it's the best one found so far.
cues.zh: 这里有一些稍微有点绕的代码，它会递归生成这个问题的所有可能解，而每个解都会在这里的这个函数里评估，方法就是计算路径长度，如果它是目前找到的最优解就保存下来。

cues.en: So for these 12 towns, let's try running the program, and it only takes a second or so to crunch the numbers, and here we have your optimal cabbage root.
cues.zh: 那么对于这 12 个城镇，我们来运行程序，它只需要一秒左右就能算出结果，这里就是你最优的卷心菜路线。

cues.en: But now let's say that a new town crops up over here which you want to visit well, so let's run the program again.
cues.zh: 但现在假设这里冒出一个新城镇，你也想去，那么我们再运行一次程序。

cues.en: This
cues.zh: 这

cues.en: time it's taking a lot longer to figure out the answer.
cues.zh: 次算出答案要花长得多的时间。

cues.en: The trouble is the number of unique solutions is equal to the number of points minus one factorial
cues.zh: 问题在于，不同解的数量等于点数减一的阶乘

cues.en: divided by two. So with three towns, it's just one solution,
cues.zh: 除以二。所以三个城镇时，只有一个解，

cues.en: but by the time we get to a modest 20 towns, there's already something outrageous like 60
cues.zh: 但等到我们只有区区 20 个城镇时，就已经有像 60 这样离谱的

cues.en: possible solutions.
cues.zh: 可能解。

cues.en: Even with much more sophisticated algorithms,
cues.zh: 即使使用复杂得多的算法，

cues.en: it's very expensive and often just completely infeasible to find the optimal solution,
cues.zh: 要找到最优解也非常昂贵，而且往往完全不可行，

cues.en: and so a lot of interesting techniques have been developed for finding something close to perfect very quickly.
cues.zh: 所以人们开发了很多有趣的技术，用来快速找到接近完美的结果。

cues.en: As I was reading up on these a little, I became intrigued by one approach in particular,
cues.zh: 我在稍微研究这些技术时，尤其对其中一种方法产生了兴趣，

cues.en: ant colony optimisation,
cues.zh: 蚁群优化，

cues.en: which is inspired by the foraging behaviour of, you guessed it, ants.
cues.zh: 它的灵感来自——你猜对了——蚂蚁的觅食行为。

cues.en: Essentially, how it goes is we place a virtual ant at one of these towns, which then needs to pick a new town to travel to that it hasn't visited yet.
cues.zh: 本质上，做法是：我们在其中一个城镇放一只虚拟蚂蚁，然后它需要选一个还没去过的新城镇前往。

cues.en: The ant would prefer some place nearby,
cues.zh: 蚂蚁会更偏好附近的地方，

cues.en: so I'll calculate each town's desirability
cues.zh: 所以我会计算每个城镇的吸引力

cues.en: as one over the distance raised to some power.
cues.zh: 也就是一除以距离的某个幂次。

cues.en: The higher that power is, the more strongly the ant will prefer the nearby towns.
cues.zh: 这个幂次越高，蚂蚁就越强烈地偏好附近的城镇。

cues.en: It will make its final decision at random, but the probabilities are weighted based on that desirability value.
cues.zh: 它会随机做出最终决定，但概率会根据那个吸引力值加权。

cues.en: So let's watch our adventurous little ant on its mission.
cues.zh: 那么来看看我们这只爱冒险的小蚂蚁执行任务吧。

cues.en: Now that it has visited every town, we can retrace its steps to see the path that it took.
cues.zh: 现在它已经访问了每个城镇，我们可以回溯它的脚步，看看它走过的路径。

cues.en: It's not a fantastic path, but solving the entire problem is a lot to ask of one tiny ant, so let's give it some friends to help it explore.
cues.zh: 这不是一条很棒的路径，但要求一只小蚂蚁解决整个问题太过分了，所以我们给它一些朋友来帮忙探索。

cues.en: Once they've all finished their journeys, what we'll do is score each of their paths by how good they are, and these will act like pheromone trails as the analogy goes to help guide the next round of ants.
cues.zh: 等它们都完成旅程后，我们要根据每条路径有多好来打分，而按照类比，这些分数会像信息素轨迹一样，帮助引导下一轮蚂蚁。

cues.en: So ultimately,
cues.zh: 所以归根结底，

cues.en: each ant chooses the next town in its path probabilistically
cues.zh: 每只蚂蚁都是根据概率来选择路径上的下一座城镇，

cues.en: based on the distance to the town and the strength of the pheromone trail there.
cues.zh: 概率则取决于城镇间的距离以及该路径上的信息素浓度。

cues.en: In that way, each new group of ants explores random variations of the best paths found so far, and any improvements are reinforced thanks to the pheromones.
cues.zh: 这样一来，每批新蚂蚁都会在已有最佳路径的基础上做随机探索，而任何优化都会借助信息素得到强化。

cues.en: Let's try run this new approach on those 20 towns from earlier to see if it actually works.
cues.zh: 让我们用这个新方法跑一下刚才那 20 座城镇，看看实际效果如何。

cues.en: I have slowed the simulation down so we can get an idea of how the pheromone trails change over time, and here it's already settled into a really good looking path.
cues.zh: 我放慢了仿真速度，方便大家观察信息素轨迹随时间的变化，看，现在它已经稳定在一条看起来非常不错的路径上了。

cues.en: It took about 50 ants a split second to find this, which is a nice improvement from the six centuries we are facing before. Although, of course, the trade off is we have no assurance that this is actually the best possible solution.
cues.zh: 大约 50 只蚂蚁只用了一瞬间就找到了这条路，相比之前要等 600 年，这提升可以说是相当惊人了。当然，代价是我们无法保证这一定是最优解。

cues.en: Just for fun, and please try to contain your excitement, I'm going to ramp this up to 100 towns.
cues.zh: 纯粹为了好玩（大家先克制一下激动的心情），我要把规模增加到 100 座城镇。

cues.en: Here again, I am showing a slowed down view of the pheromone trails,
cues.zh: 这里展示的同样是放慢速度后的信息素轨迹，

cues.en: but it's maybe interesting as well if I run it again and instead display the best path the ants have found so far, so we can see how that develops over time as well.
cues.zh: 不过如果重跑一次，改为显示蚂蚁目前找到的最佳路径，应该也挺有意思，这样我们就能看到最优解是如何随时间演进的。

cues.en: So I think this is a really cool algorithm, the only slightly annoying thing is there are a number of parameters for controlling the simulation, and it does take a bit of trial and error to find values that work well for a given problem.
cues.zh: 我觉得这个算法真的很酷，唯一有点烦人的是控制仿真的参数挺多，确实需要反复试错，才能为特定问题调出一套好参数。

cues.en: Anyway, this has got me interested in playing around with a less practical but more sort of fun visual simulation of ants.
cues.zh: 无论如何，这激起了我的兴趣，想做一个没那么实用、但更有趣的蚂蚁视觉仿真。

cues.en: So I started by making a simple flat ant graphic and brought it to life a little with a crude walk animation.
cues.zh: 于是我先做了一个简单的扁平蚂蚁图形，并配上粗糙的行走动画，让它稍微生动一点。

cues.en: I then imported it into Unity, but something went terribly wrong in the process.
cues.zh: 然后我把它导入 Unity，但导入过程中出了点大岔子。

cues.en: And the result was mildly terrifying.
cues.zh: 出来的效果甚至有点吓人。

cues.en: I got it working in the end though and wrote some code to make it follow this green dot around which is gonna represent the ants' food source.
cues.zh: 不过最后我还是搞定了，还写了点代码让它跟着这个绿点跑，绿点代表蚂蚁的食物源。

cues.en: Here's the ants' code as it stands right now, and I want to modify this quickly to get the ant to wander about on its own. I'll try achieve this by simply nudging the desired direction by some random vector each frame, and let's see how that looks.
cues.zh: 这是蚂蚁目前的代码，我想快速改一下，让它能自己到处漫游。我打算通过每帧给目标方向叠加上一个随机向量来实现，来看看效果如何。

cues.en: This ant is too indecisive and not making much progress in its life, but I can turn the wonder strength way down, and now it's exploring its surroundings quite nicely.
cues.zh: 这只蚂蚁太优柔寡断了，“蚁生”毫无进展，不过我把漫游强度调小很多之后，现在它探索周围环境的表现就相当不错了。

cues.en: I think the next step should be for the ant to be able to sense food if it's nearby and pick it up. So I've added some lines of code for handling that, and let's test this with just one ant to start with.
cues.zh: 接下来应该让蚂蚁能感知附近的食物并捡起来。所以我加了几行代码来处理，我们先用一只蚂蚁来测试。

cues.en: That's working well I think, so now I'll test this with a bunch of ants.
cues.zh: 看起来运行得不错，那现在我就用一群蚂蚁来测测看。

cues.en: The ants shouldn't just greedily keep all the food they find for themselves, they need to take it back home to support the colony.
cues.zh: 蚂蚁不该贪心地把找到的食物全留给自己，它们得把食物搬回家，供养整个蚁群。

cues.en: I really don't know much about ants, so I did a little research about how they even find their way home.
cues.zh: 我对蚂蚁了解不多，所以稍微研究了一下它们到底是怎么找到回家的路的。

cues.en: It turns out they are smarter than I'd imagined. For example, beyond recognizing landmarks, which is pretty impressive,
cues.zh: 结果发现它们比我想象的还聪明。比如，除了能识别地标——这已经挺厉害了，

cues.en: some desert dwelling species are apparently able to combine directional information from polarized light with distance information from essentially an internal pedometer
cues.zh: 有些生活在沙漠里的种类显然还能把偏振光提供的方向信息，与本质上来自体内计步器的距离信息结合起来

cues.en: to calculate a straight path back home.
cues.zh: 从而计算出一条回家的直线路径。

cues.en: I'd like to keep things simple though and have all navigation done via pheromones.
cues.zh: 不过我想保持简单，让所有导航都通过信息素来完成。

cues.en: So inspired by this really cool video that I came across, I'm going to have the ants use two types of pheromones.
cues.zh: 受我偶然看到的一个很酷的视频启发，我打算让蚂蚁使用两种信息素。

cues.en: This blue one, they lay down when leaving their home to search for food, and then if they actually find food, they should turn around and follow the blue pheromones home while laying down these red pheromones
cues.zh: 这种蓝色的，是它们离家寻找食物时留下的；如果真找到了食物，它们就该掉头沿着蓝色信息素回家，同时留下这些红色信息素

cues.en: to try recruit other ants to the food source.
cues.zh: 来试着把其他蚂蚁招募到食物源。

cues.en: They're not doing a great job at the moment, but that's not their fault. I haven't actually implemented the pheromone following yet.
cues.zh: 它们目前干得不太行，但这不是它们的错。我其实还没实现信息素跟随。

cues.en: So for that, I need to ask each ant to sample three regions in front of it,
cues.zh: 为此，我需要让每只蚂蚁采样前方的三个区域，

cues.en: and based on the concentration of pheromones it detects in these regions, it will either turn left, keep moving forwards, or turn right, plus a little bit of random turning still on top of that.
cues.zh: 然后根据它在这些区域检测到的信息素浓度，决定左转、继续前进还是右转，另外还会叠加一点随机转向。

cues.en: I think this is a nice simple way of handling it, which I actually came across in this paper which describes an approach that problem we looked at at the start of the video inspired by slime molds of all things.
cues.zh: 我觉得这是一种简单又优雅的处理方式；我其实是在一篇论文里看到的，它描述的是视频开头我们看过的那个问题的一种解法，灵感居然来自黏菌。

cues.en: It's quite intriguing, so I might come back to it. But for now, I'll just be borrowing this little sensory scheme for the ants.
cues.zh: 这挺有意思的，所以我之后可能会回头再讲。但现在，我只借用这个小感知方案给蚂蚁用。

cues.en: Here's the actual code for it, and as you can see down here, I've made the pheromones lose strength over time to sort of mimic the effect of evaporation.
cues.zh: 这是它的实际代码；如你在下面所见，我让信息素随时间减弱，算是模拟蒸发效果。

cues.en: I'd really like the pheromones to also diffuse outwards over time, but I'm not quite sure how to handle that yet.
cues.zh: 我很希望信息素还能随时间向外扩散，但我还不太确定该怎么处理。

cues.en: Anyway, let's give this a quick trial run with a handful of ants.
cues.zh: 总之，我们先拿几只蚂蚁快速试跑一下。

cues.en: Okay. It seems to be working roughly how I intended, so next up, I want the ants to be able to avoid obstacles or at least not simply walk right through them. So I've spent a bit of time writing some dubious collision detection code, which does nevertheless seem to be getting the job done.
cues.zh: 好。看起来基本按我的预期在运行。接下来，我想让蚂蚁能避开障碍物，至少别直接穿过去。所以我花了一点时间写了一些不太靠谱的碰撞检测代码，不过它似乎确实能完成任务。

cues.en: I then wanted to generate some sort of map like one of these from this ancient tutorial series of mine.
cues.zh: 然后我想生成某种地图，就像我早年的教程系列里的这种。

cues.en: I have a strong aversion to my old code though, so instead of reusing that project like a reasonable person, I began reimplementing it all from scratch.
cues.zh: 但我很反感自己的旧代码，所以没有像个正常人那样复用那个项目，而是从头开始重新实现了一遍。

cues.en: After several hours work, however, I came to the realization that my new code is not so great either.
cues.zh: 不过，干了几个小时后，我意识到我的新代码也没那么好。

cues.en: Fast forwarding through some frustration, I eventually did get it working, and I also added a brush that I could easily paint in obstacles or carve out little passage ways.
cues.zh: 快进过一些挫败后，我最终确实让它跑通了，还加了一个画笔，可以轻松刷出障碍物或挖出小通道。

cues.en: Come to think of it, I could have just taken two minutes to draw this in paint, but anyway, I ended up making this map for the ants, and I wrote a simple spawner script to scatter some clumps of food about the place.
cues.zh: 回头想想，我本来花两分钟用画图就能画出这个，但总之，我最后还是给蚂蚁做了这张地图，并写了一个简单的生成脚本，在地图各处撒一些食物团。

cues.en: And so with all this set up, let's unleash 500 ants from their nest and see what they get up to.
cues.zh: 那么既然都设置好了，我们就从巢里放出 500 只蚂蚁，看看它们会干什么。

cues.en: Over on the right, the ants have collected that entire food cluster,
cues.zh: 右边，蚂蚁已经收集完了那一整簇食物，

cues.en: but they'll keep returning there for a while still until the pheromone trail has finally evaporated.
cues.zh: 但它们还会继续回到那里一阵子，直到信息素轨迹最终消散。

cues.en: Real ants are vastly more sophisticated than what I'm simulating here, of course, and in this situation, for example, I read that pheromones
cues.zh: 当然，真实蚂蚁远比我在这里模拟的复杂得多；比如在这种情况下，我读到信息素

cues.en: have been found to actually deposit repellent pheromones when a resource has been depleted to discourage future ants from that trail.
cues.zh: 在资源耗尽时，实际上会沉积驱避信息素，以阻止后来的蚂蚁再走那条轨迹。

cues.en: This has been fun to play with and there are many things I'd still like to try out, but my attention has been sidetracked somewhat by these strange
cues.zh: 这个玩起来挺有意思，我还有很多东西想尝试，但我的注意力有点被这些奇怪的

cues.en: slime mold organisms.
cues.zh: 黏菌生物给带偏了。

cues.en: Here's another slime paper I came across, this time about pattern formation.
cues.zh: 这是我偶然看到的另一篇黏菌论文，这次是关于图案形成的。

cues.en: The behaviour described here is pretty similar to the ant stuff I've been doing, but I'd like to give it a quick try and this time I want to implement it as a compute shader so that I can hopefully do a much larger simulation.
cues.zh: 这里描述的行为和我一直在做的蚂蚁那套挺像，但我想快速试一下；这次我想把它实现成计算着色器，希望能做规模大得多的模拟。

cues.en: The first thing I wanted to get working was generating pseudo random numbers in the shader.
cues.zh: 我首先想搞定的，是在着色器里生成伪随机数。

cues.en: I saw a recommendation for using this little function, which takes in a number and just fiddles with the bits a little. There nothing actually random about this of course, but the outputs should hopefully be very different for inputs which are close together.
cues.zh: 我看到有人推荐使用这个小函数，它接收一个数，只对二进制位稍微摆弄一下。当然这其实一点也不随机，但对于很接近的输入，输出应该会差别很大。

cues.en: To test it, I have this little function, which is going to be run-in parallel for every pixel in a texture that I've given it.
cues.zh: 为了测试它，我写了这个小函数，它会在我传给它的纹理上对每个像素并行运行。

cues.en: We can start by getting the index of the current pixel, which will be zero for the first pixel, one for the next, and so on, and then we can generate a pseudo random number for that pixel simply by passing the index through the hash function.
cues.zh: 我们可以先取当前像素的索引——第一个像素是 0，下一个是 1，依此类推——然后只要把索引传给哈希函数，就能为那个像素生成一个伪随机数。

cues.en: I'll set the brightness of the current pixel to that value divided by the maximum possible value just to scale it between zero and one. And let's now take a look at the result.
cues.zh: 我会把当前像素的亮度设成那个值除以最大可能值，只是为了把它缩放到 0 到 1 之间。现在来看看结果。

cues.en: So it seems like we have some nice random looking noise, but let me increase the size of the texture just to see if this still holds up. We're on the lookout for any suspicious repeating patterns,
cues.zh: 看起来我们得到了一些不错的、看起来随机的噪声，但让我把纹理尺寸调大，看看这样是否还成立。我们要留意任何可疑的重复模式，

cues.en: for example if it looked like this, or even worse like this, we should definitely use a different hash function.
cues.zh: 比如如果它看起来像这样，或者更糟，像这样，那我们肯定得换一个哈希函数。

cues.en: But I think it was looking good.
cues.zh: 不过我觉得它看起来还不错。

cues.en: So I've now started work on the slime simulation.
cues.zh: 所以我现在开始做黏菌模拟了。

cues.en: First of all, I've created this agent structure which simply holds a position and an angle,
cues.zh: 首先，我创建了这个 agent 结构体，里面只保存位置和角度，

cues.en: and then I have some code for updating each agent.
cues.zh: 然后有一段代码用来更新每个 agent。

cues.en: The update rule is very simple at the moment. Just move the agent based on its current angle, and if it tries to go off the edge of the screen, don't let it, and turn it to face some new random angle.
cues.zh: 目前更新规则很简单：根据当前角度移动 agent；如果它要跑出屏幕边缘，就阻止它，并把它转向一个随机的新角度。

cues.en: At the end, I have this trail map texture, and I'm just recording the agent's position as a white pixel in there. Let's see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 最后，我有一张轨迹图纹理，把 agent 的位置记录成里面的白色像素。看看效果如何。

cues.en: Not terribly interesting so far, unsurprisingly.
cues.zh: 目前还不太有意思，也不意外。

cues.en: Now just like with the ants, we want these trails to evaporate over time, So I'll make another function that runs for every pixel in the trail map and just subtracts a little bit each frame. You can probably imagine how this looks, but I'll show it anyway.
cues.zh: 现在和蚂蚁那期一样，我们希望这些轨迹随时间蒸发，所以我会再写一个函数，遍历轨迹图中的每个像素，每帧减去一点点。你大概能想象效果，不过我还是展示一下。

cues.en: Next, we want the trails to diffuse over time, which is something I never got around to implementing for the ants, but it's really simple with this setup because the map is an image, so we can just blur it a little each frame.
cues.zh: 接下来，我们希望轨迹随时间扩散。这个在蚂蚁那期我一直没来得及实现，但在这套设置里很简单，因为轨迹图就是一张图像，所以每帧模糊一下就行。

cues.en: Here's my very crude code for that, which just sets the color of each pixel to be the average of its neighbors.
cues.zh: 这是我非常粗糙的实现：把每个像素的颜色设成它邻居的平均值。

cues.en: Now we just need to make these agents attracted to the trails, so I've added this code which simply senses the concentration of the trail at three points in front of the agent like before and turns based on that. And there's also some randomness involved.
cues.zh: 现在我们只需要让这些 agent 被轨迹吸引，所以我加了这段代码：像之前一样感知 agent 前方三个点的轨迹浓度，并据此转向。其中也加入了一些随机性。

cues.en: The sense function looks like this, and in here it's simply adding up all the values in the trail texture that lie inside the bounds of the sensor.
cues.zh: 感知函数长这样，里面就是把传感器范围内轨迹纹理的所有值加起来。

cues.en: Let's have a look at the result.
cues.zh: 来看看结果。

cues.en: This is currently taking place on a very small scale, it's a three twenty x 180 map with two fifty agents.
cues.zh: 目前规模非常小：320×180 的地图，250 个 agent。

cues.en: But because we've taken the trouble to write this as a compute shader which runs on the GPU, it should be able to handle something much bigger.
cues.zh: 但因为我们特意把它写成了在 GPU 上运行的计算着色器，它应该能处理大得多的规模。

cues.en: For our first experiment, I have initialized the agents with random positions inside a circle, all facing towards the center, and let's see how this evolves over time.
cues.zh: 第一个实验里，我把 agent 随机初始化在一个圆内，全部朝向圆心，看看它会随时间如何演化。

cues.en: So these have been pretty interesting looking I think, but let's try making multiple species of slime.
cues.zh: 我觉得这些效果看起来挺有意思，不过我们试试做多个种类的黏菌。

cues.en: This should actually be pretty simple. I'll go into the agent structure and add a species mask,
cues.zh: 这其实应该很简单。我会进入 agent 结构体，加一个种类掩码，

cues.en: so each agent can belong to one of four different species.
cues.zh: 这样每个 agent 就可以属于四种不同种类之一。

cues.en: Then when drawing the trail, I'll draw into the red, green, blue or alpha channel texture based on that mask.
cues.zh: 然后绘制轨迹时，根据这个掩码画到红、绿、蓝或 alpha 通道纹理里。

cues.en: And finally, in the sense function, I'll just modify this line so that it treats the trails of other species as negative,
cues.zh: 最后，在感知函数里，我只要改这一行，把其他种类的轨迹当作负值，

cues.en: so it should try steer away from them.
cues.zh: 这样它就会尽量避开它们。

cues.en: Let's try a simple test with red and green slime.
cues.zh: 我们先用红色和绿色史莱姆做个简单测试。

cues.en: That's kind of cool. Let's try mutating a third of the population into blue slime and see what that looks like.
cues.zh: 挺酷的。我们试着把三分之一种群变异成蓝色史莱姆，看看效果。

cues.en: I find it quite fascinating seeing these organic looking patterns emerge from those really simple rules that we've implemented.
cues.zh: 看到这些很有机感的图案从我们实现的简单规则中涌现，我觉得很着迷。

cues.en: There's definitely much more to explore here, but other projects are calling, so I'm going to leave this here for now.
cues.zh: 这里肯定还有很多可探索的，但其他项目在召唤，所以暂时先到这里。

cues.en: I'll put links in the description though to some far more impressive stuff that others have done with this technique, in case you're interested in checking those out.
cues.zh: 不过我会在简介里放一些链接，指向其他人用这项技术做出的更惊艳的东西，感兴趣可以去看看。

cues.en: In any case, I hope you've enjoyed the video, and until next time, cheers.
cues.zh: 总之，希望你喜欢这个视频，下次见，拜拜。
